update PBC_REPORT_BALANCE
REPORTTYPE = #{reporttype,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
GROUPTYPE = #{grouptype,jdbcType=VARCHAR},

update PBC_REPORT_BALANCE set REPORTTYPE = #{reporttype,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, GROUPTYPE = #{grouptype,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PROPERTYCODE = #{propertycode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CNY = #{cny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, USD_TO_CNY = #{usdToCny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, EUR_TO_CNY = #{eurToCny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, GBP_TO_CNY = #{gbpToCny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, JPY_TO_CNY = #{jpyToCny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, OTH_TO_CNY = #{othToCny,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, TOTAL = #{total,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, REPORTUUID = #{reportuuid,jdbcType=CHAR}, CCY_AMOUNT = #{ccyAmount,jdbcType=CHAR} where DETAILUUID = #{detailuuid,jdbcType=CHAR}
mapper.select: select b.item_value as industryFactorName, ifnull(c.item_value,d.item_value) as areaCodeName, e.item_value as typeOfBorrowerName, a.BORROWER_ID as borrowerCode, f.item_value as originalCcyName, a.ORIG_CONTRACT_AMOUNT as originalContractAmount, a.ORIG_CONTRACT_AMOUNT_CNY as originalContractAmountRmb, g.item_value as loanCcy, a.CONTRACT_AMOUNT as loanBalance, a.CONTRACT_AMOUNT_CNY as loanBalanceRmb, a.LOAN_TRANSFEROR_NAME as transferorAgency, a.LOAN_CONTRACT_ORG_NAME as originalIssuer, h.item_value as originalIssuerLocation, ifnull(ifnull(i.item_value,j.item_value),k.item_value) as economicComponent, l.item_value as enterpriseScale, a.LOAN_BASIS_ID as loanIouCode, m.item_value as loanProductCategory, n.item_value as actualInvestmentLoans, a.LOAN_VDATE as dateLoanIssuance, a.LOAN_MDATE as loanMaturityDate, a.LOAN_EXTENSION_DUE_DATE as maturityDateLoanRollover, o.item_value as isTheInterestRate, a.RATE_LEVEL as interestRates, p.item_value as loanGuaranteeMethod, q.item_value as paymentForGoodsQuality, r.item_value as paymentStatus, a.LOAN_TRANSFEROR_RATE as transferDiscountRate, s.item_value as loanTypeName from PBC_LOAN_DETAIL_INFO_SUB a LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST b ON a.industry_info = b.item_code and b.DICT_CODE = 'SVR_INDUSTRY_DOOR_CODE' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST c ON a.BORROWER_COUNTY = c.item_code and c.DICT_CODE = 'AREA_TYPE3' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST d on a.BORROWER_NATIONALITY = d.item_code and d.DICT_CODE = 'SVR_COUNTRY_AREA' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST e on a.BORROWER_TYPE = e.item_code and e.DICT_CODE = 'SVR_PBC_CUSTTYPE' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST f on a.ORIG_CCY = f.item_code and f.DICT_CODE = 'CURRENCY_CHB' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST g on a.AMT_CCY = g.item_code and g.DICT_CODE = 'CURRENCY_CHB' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST h on a.LOAN_CONTRACT_ORG_COUNTY = h.item_code and h.DICT_CODE = 'AREA_TYPE3' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST i on a.ENTERPRISE_INVESTOR_TYPE_THIRD = i.item_code and i.dict_code = 'SVR_ECONOMIC_THIRD_LEVEL' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST j on a.ENTERPRISE_INVESTOR_TYPE_SEC = j.item_code and j.dict_code = 'SVR_ECONOMIC_SECOND_LEVEL' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST k on a.ENTERPRISE_INVESTOR_TYPE_FIRST = k.item_code and k.dict_code = 'SVR_ECONOMIC_FIRST_LEVEL' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST l on a.ENTERPRISE_SCALE = l.item_code and l.dict_code = 'SVR_SCALE' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST m on a.LOAN_PRD_TYPE = m.item_code and m.dict_code = 'SVR_LOAN_PEOD_TYPE' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST n on a.LOAN_ACTUAL_INVEST = n.item_code and n.dict_code = 'SVR_INDUSTRY_CATE_CODE' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST o on a.RATE_FIXED = o.item_code and o.dict_code = 'SVR_INTEREST_TYPE' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST p on a.LOAN_GUARANTEE_MODE = p.item_code and p.dict_code = 'SVR_LOAN_GUA_TYPE' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST q on a.LOAN_QUALITY = q.item_code and q.dict_code = 'SVR_LOAN_QUALITY' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST r on a.LOAN_STATE = r.item_code and r.dict_code = 'SVR_LOAN_STATUS' LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST s on a.LOANS_TYPE = s.item_code and s.dict_code = 'SVR_LOAN_TYPE' where a.REPORTUUID = #{reportuuid,jdbcType=CHAR}

select t.POBCASSETID as inputProductCode, t.CCY as inputProductCcy, t.PBC_ACCOUNT_ID as pbcAccountId, cast(sum(ifnull(t.CAPITAL_TRUST_AMOUNT,0)) AS decimal(30,2)) as inputProductAmount, cast(sum(ifnull(t.CAPITAL_TRUST_AMOUNT_CNY,0)) AS decimal(30,2)) as inputProductCcyRmb from PBC_CAPITAL_TRUST_DETAIL_SUB t where t.reportuuid = #{reportuuid,jdbcType=CHAR} group by t.POBCASSETID,t.PBC_ACCOUNT_ID,t.CCY

select pldinfo.PBC_ACCOUNT_ID pbcAccountId,/*资产池代码*/ pldinfo.LOANS_TYPE loansType,/*贷款种类*/ pldinfo.LOAN_TRANSFEROR_ID loanTransferorId,/*贷款转让方机构代码*/ pldinfo.LOAN_CONTRACT_ORG_ID loanContractOrgId,/*贷款合同原始发放机构代码*/ pldinfo.LOAN_CONTRACT_ORG_COUNTY loanContractOrgCounty,/*贷款合同原始发放机构所在地(县)*/ pldinfo.BORROWER_TYPE borrowerType,/*借款人类型*/ ifnull(pldinfo.BORROWER_COUNTY,pldinfo.BORROWER_NATIONALITY) borrowerCounty,/*地区代码*/ pldinfo.BORROWER_ID borrowerId,/*借款人代码*/ pldinfo.INDUSTRY_INFO industryInfo,/*行业信息*/ COALESCE(pldinfo.ENTERPRISE_INVESTOR_TYPE_THIRD,pldinfo.ENTERPRISE_INVESTOR_TYPE_SEC,pldinfo.ENTERPRISE_INVESTOR_TYPE_FIRST) enterpriseInvestorType,/*企业出资人经济成分*/ pldinfo.ENTERPRISE_SCALE enterpriseScale,/*企业规模*/ pldinfo.LOAN_BASIS_ID loanBasisId,/*贷款借据编码*/ pldinfo.LOAN_PRD_TYPE loanPrdType,/*贷款产品类别*/ pldinfo.LOAN_ACTUAL_INVEST loanActualInvest,/*贷款实际投向*/ pldinfo.LOAN_VDATE loanVdate,/*贷款发放日期*/ pldinfo.LOAN_MDATE loanMdate,/*贷款到期日期*/ pldinfo.LOAN_EXTENSION_DUE_DATE loanExtensionDueDate,/*贷款展期到期日期*/ pldinfo.RATE_FIXED rateFixed,/*利率是否固定*/ pldinfo.RATE_LEVEL rateLevel,/*利率水平(%)*/ pldinfo.LOAN_GUARANTEE_MODE loanGuaranteeMode,/*贷款担保方式*/ pldinfo.LOAN_QUALITY loanQuality,/*贷款质量*/ pldinfo.LOAN_STATE loanState,/*贷款状态*/ pldinfo.LOAN_TRANSFEROR_RATE loanTransferorRate,/*贷款转让折扣率(%)*/ pldinfo.ORIG_CCY origCcy,/*原始合同币种代码*/ pldinfo.ORIG_CONTRACT_AMOUNT origContractAmount,/*原始合同金额*/ pldinfo.ORIG_CONTRACT_AMOUNT_CNY origContractAmountCny,/*原始合同金额折人民币*/ pldinfo.AMT_CCY amtCcy,/*贷款余额币种代码*/ pldinfo.CONTRACT_AMOUNT contractAmount,/*贷款余额*/ pldinfo.CONTRACT_AMOUNT_CNY contractAmountCny/*贷款余额折人民币*/ from PBC_LOAN_DETAIL_INFO_SUB pldinfo where pldinfo.REPORTUUID = #{reportuuid,jdbcType=CHAR}

select pctds.PBC_ACCOUNT_ID pbcAccountId,/*资产池代码*/ pctds.STOCK_TYPE stockType,/*股权种类*/ pctds.CAPITAL_TRUST_ORG_CODE capitalTrustOrgCode,/*产品发起机构编码*/ pctds.POBCASSETID pobcassetid,/*人行资金信托代码*/ pctds.CCY ccy,/*币种代码*/ sum(pctds.CAPITAL_TRUST_AMOUNT) capitalTrustAmount,/*资金信托产品余额*/ sum(pctds.CAPITAL_TRUST_AMOUNT_CNY) capitalTrustAmountCny/*资金信托产品余额折人民币*/ from PBC_CAPITAL_TRUST_DETAIL_SUB pctds where pctds.REPORTUUID = #{reportuuid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by pctds.PBC_ACCOUNT_ID, pctds.POBCASSETID, pctds.CCY, pctds.STOCK_TYPE, pctds.CAPITAL_TRUST_ORG_CODE

select DETAILUUID, REPORTTYPE, GROUPTYPE, PROPERTYCODE, CNY, USD_TO_CNY, TOTAL as TOTAL, REPORTUUID,substring(substring(CCY_AMOUNT, INSTR(CCY_AMOUNT,'USD,')+4), 1, INSTR(substring(CCY_AMOUNT, INSTR(CCY_AMOUNT,'USD,')+4),',')-1) AS CCY_AMOUNT from PBC_REPORT_BALANCE where REPORTUUID = #{reportuuid,jdbcType=CHAR}
